name: Computer Physics
about: Physics and mathematics combined with computational methods: modelling, simulation and data analysis of physical and engineering problems, at the Faculty of Physics and Applied Computer Science.

name: Computer Science
about: Building and using computer systems: maths and physics foundations, programming, PC and mobile systems, administration and data analysis, run by four AGH faculties together.

name: Computer Science for Embedded Systems
about: Designing embedded systems like those in cars, robots, IoT devices and medical equipment, from hardware to software, with lab work, team projects and simulation and testing tools.

name: Geology of Natural Resources
about: Finding and assessing mineral deposits for the energy transition and critical raw materials: geochemistry, geophysics, GIS and data modelling, with lab and field classes.

name: Mechanical Engineering
about: Designing mechanical systems: materials, strength, corrosion and manufacturing technology, at the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Robotics.

name: Mechatronic Engineering
about: Mechanics, control, electronics and computing brought together: computer-aided engineering, virtual prototyping, modern control and the basics of robotics.

name: Space Engineering
about: Designing, integrating and operating space systems: spacecraft and satellites, propulsion, avionics, flight dynamics and ground segment, in design studios and mission projects with an internship.

name: Chemistry
about: General chemistry in English: analytical, inorganic, organic and physical chemistry, chemical technology and instrumental and spectral analysis, with much of the work done in the lab.

name: European Legal Studies
about: How European integration shapes law, the economy and daily life: human rights, EU trade and consumer law, data protection and intellectual property, with focus tracks in law, business and society in year three.

name: Central European and Balkan Studies
about: Literature, languages and cultures of Central Europe and the Balkans, taught through Polish studies, Slavic studies and classical philology, with practical communication for cultural tourism and business.

name: English Linguistics: Theories, Interfaces, Technologies
about: Theoretical and experimental linguistics (phonology, syntax, psycholinguistics, sociolinguistics) combined with language technology: text processing, language databases and speech analysis, plus academic English and internships.

name: International Relations
about: War, peace, conflict and cooperation between states: international law, economics, diplomacy, negotiation and foreign policy, with specialties in Geopolitics and Strategic Studies or Global Economy and International Business.

name: Liberal Arts and Sciences
about: A European liberal arts degree: core courses in philosophy, logic, research methods and academic writing, disciplinary courses from biology to history, Greek and Latin, and electives from other AMU faculties.

name: Global Communication
about: Linguistics, literature and communication studies across the English-speaking and East Slavic worlds: English and Russian to B2+ level, plus an optional third language (Spanish, German, Belarusian or Ukrainian).

name: Applied Linguistics and Intercultural Communication
about: Using languages in multicultural settings: English and German grammar, contrastive linguistics, public speaking and intercultural training, with German from the start and a third language (Spanish or French).

name: Governance of Organizations
about: Leading and managing organisations, drawing on political science, law and communication: ESG, compliance, conflict management and AI tools, plus an intensive foreign language (preferably German) to B2.

name: Bachelor in Management
about: Management, finance, accounting and HR with courses on generative AI for managers; pick a major in marketing, international management, entrepreneurship or luxury management, with a fifth-semester exchange window and double degrees with partner schools.

name: Sustainable Business - Major on the Bachelor in Management Program
about: The Management degree's sustainability major with ESCP Business School: year one in Warsaw, then ESCP campuses such as Madrid, Turin, Paris, Berlin or London, covering ESG, green economics and sustainable business models, and ending with two diplomas.

name: Bachelor in Management and Artificial Intelligence
about: Management combined with programming (mainly Python and R), data analytics and machine learning used in business, with group start-up or implementation projects under staff supervision from the second semester.

name: Bachelor in Management and Sociology in Business and Media
about: Management joined with the sociology of media and digital technology: many discussion and workshop classes, content creation, research and communication skills, and required internships in traditional and new media.

name: Bachelor in Finance and Accounting
about: Finance and accounting with sustainability and digital finance built in: majors in corporate finance and financial markets, green finance, or fintech, preparation for the CFA Investment Foundations certificate, and double degrees at ISEG, Aston or IESEG.

name: Doctor of Medicine
about: Six-year, 360-ECTS Doctor of Medicine programme of the Faculty of Medicine, taught in English in Gdansk and opening with a compulsory Orientation Week; MUG lists WFME, NCFMEA and MCI recognition for it.

name: Master of Pharmacy
about: The science of how medicines are discovered, developed and delivered and how patients respond to them, ending with six months of pre-registration training in a pharmacy; it leads to registration as a pharmacist in Poland, recognised in other EU states.

name: Bachelor of Nursing
about: Basic and social sciences, then nursing care from primary care to specialist fields such as paediatrics, surgery, psychiatry, geriatrics and palliative care, on a curriculum built to European and US standards.

name: Medicine
about: Six-year, 360-ECTS medical degree straight from school: basic sciences first, patient contact from year two, clinical rotations from year four in PUMS's own hospitals, with NBME exams and a Kaplan review course built in.

name: Dentistry
about: Five-year, 300-ECTS dental degree straight from school: medical sciences first, then from year three treating patients in the PUMS Dental Clinic, with a dental simulation centre and summer clinical training each year.

name: Architecture
about: Four-year engineering degree in architectural and urban design, taught by practising architects: technical drawing, designing buildings and organising space, with a focus on healthcare design, energy-efficient buildings and heritage.

name: Artificial Intelligence
about: Computer science centred on artificial intelligence: algorithms, machine learning and neural networks, data analysis, optimisation and decision analysis, and AI in robotics, with a four-week internship after the third year.

name: Automatic Control and Robotics
about: Industrial control and measurement systems, modelling and programming robotic workstations, and designing simple automation systems, much of it in well-equipped labs, with technical English to B2.

name: Biomedical Engineering
about: Engineering applied to the human body: designing medical and rehabilitation equipment, prostheses and implants, and working with doctors and physiotherapists on technology used in hospitals and clinics.

name: Chemical Technology
about: Chemistry joined to process engineering for making chemical products at industrial scale, aimed at the chemical, food and cosmetics industries and taught largely through laboratory and project classes.

name: Engineering Management
about: Management and economics combined with engineering: linking technical and business problems and running IT systems, for roles such as market analyst, sales manager or manager in a production company.

name: Mechanical Engineering
about: A new English-taught programme in machine design and manufacturing: materials, CAD/CAE/CAM tools, simulation and experiments, and how machines, robots and mechatronic systems work, through labs and team projects.

name: Microelectronics and Digital Communication
about: Three strands: microelectronics (microcomputers, FPGAs, circuit-board design), programming processors from x86 to ARM, and digital communication from satellites to smartphones, plus XR/VR and sensor networks.

name: Quantum Technologies
about: Quantum physics with classical and quantum computing, AI, photonics and electronics on a materials-engineering core: programming quantum computers, designing quantum sensors and building quantum communication systems.

name: Sustainable Building Engineering
about: Designing, building and running low-energy buildings and their water, heating, ventilation and air-conditioning systems, using CAD, CAM and BIM tools, with life-cycle cost and environmental assessment.

name: Architecture
about: A four-year engineering course in architectural and urban design (IDEAS) at the Faculty of Architecture, with weight on BIM, energy-efficient buildings, daylight and circular-economy design; a master's leads on to a licence.

name: Electric and Hybrid Vehicles Engineering
about: Designing, testing and servicing electric and hybrid cars, including autonomous vehicles: powertrain modelling, energy recovery and storage, vehicle structures and mechatronic control, at the Faculty of Automotive and Construction Machinery.

name: Environmental Engineering
about: Building services (HVAC) and water, sewage, gas and district-heating networks for sustainable, resilient cities; the path leads towards Polish professional construction licences.

name: Environmental Protection
about: A new interdisciplinary course on environmental monitoring, modelling and assessment, pollution control and climate neutrality; over 60% of classes are practical, including a project-based module.

name: Civil Engineering
about: Buildings, bridges, roads and railways from design to maintenance, on a base of maths, physics and mechanics; in year 4 you choose a specialisation such as structures, construction management or transport.

name: Electrical Engineering
about: Circuits, electrical machines, power systems, converter drives and high-voltage technology, with specialisations in control and computer engineering or electrical power engineering.

name: Computer Science
about: A four-year course at the Faculty of Electronics and Information Technology, specialising in computer systems and networks: algorithms, operating systems, databases, security and software engineering on a two-year ICT common core.

name: Computer Science and Information Systems
about: Computer science taught at the Faculty of Mathematics and Information Science: three semesters of heavy maths first, then programming, algorithms, networks and AI, with electives from semester 5 and team projects.

name: Mechatronics
about: Designing mechatronic devices: sensors, drives, microcontrollers and CAD; after semester 4 you choose Mechatronic Devices and Systems or Photonics Engineering (optics, lasers, machine vision).

name: Aerospace Engineering
about: Aircraft and spacecraft engineering: flight mechanics, aerospace materials, propulsion and rotorcraft, after a first year of maths, physics and mechanics; specialise in propulsion or structures and systems after semester 4.

name: Power Engineering
about: Thermal and electrical energy systems: thermodynamics, heat transfer, turbines, boilers, heat pumps, renewable sources and power grids, ending with a supervised engineering thesis.

name: Global Business, Finance and Governance
about: Economics, finance, management, marketing and international trade for work in international business and finance, with a minor in EU integration, global development and governance, international business or international finance; four double-degree options.

name: International Economics
about: How trade, international finance and European integration shape firms and states: three semesters of economics, accounting and statistics, then international economics, business, and politics and law, with a minor in the digital economy, EU membership or international entrepreneurship.

name: Management
about: How organisations work and how to plan, organise, motivate and control them, grounded in economics, with a minor in entrepreneurship, marketing or project management; aimed at specialist and junior manager roles or running your own business.

name: Quantitative Methods in Economics and Information Systems
about: Economics and finance with statistics, econometrics, operations research, programming and information-systems design, taught in small lab groups, with a minor in econometrics or decision analysis. It assumes school maths and probability; no coding needed.

name: Psychology
about: Cognition, emotion, personality, social and developmental psychology and psychopathology, with methods, statistics and psychometrics, taught to the EuroPsy standard; at least one project course each year and courses on clinical, school and organisational psychology.

name: Psychology
about: Cognition, emotion, personality, social and developmental psychology and psychopathology, with methods, statistics and psychometrics on the Kraków campus; clinical, school and work applications and a project course every year.

name: Psychology
about: Emotion, motivation, cognition, personality and individual differences, social psychology, and psychology in education, work and healthcare, with supervised work in behavioural research labs on the Wrocław campus.

name: Psychology
about: Cognition, emotion, personality, social and developmental psychology and psychopathology, with methods, statistics and psychometrics on the seaside Sopot campus in the Tri-City; clinical, school and work applications and a project course every year.

name: Computer Science
about: Algorithms, data structures and maths with coding in Python, Java and JavaScript, then a track in cybersecurity or AI and machine learning; a practical degree with projects, internships and some psychology and social science.

name: Design
about: School of Form's design degree: a shared first year of 2D and 3D design and hands-on workshop craft, then a specialisation in Message (communication), Object (product) or Space, ending with a graduation project under two supervisors.

name: English Studies
about: Practical English to C1, linguistics, phonetics, and British and American literature and culture, with academic writing and translation tools; from the end of year one a study track such as teaching English (TEFL) or translation.

name: English Studies with Additional Language
about: The English Studies core (C1 English, linguistics, literature, academic writing) plus a second language taken to at least B2: Chinese, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean or Spanish. Some language pairs fill early.

name: Management and Leadership
about: Hands-on management: teams and projects, leadership, business plans, economics and accounting, social innovation and data-driven decisions, with 960 hours of internships and a body of professional work in place of a thesis.

name: Earth Sciences in a Changing World
about: Geography, geology and human change to the environment, and how they shape local communities and global change, with lab and field work at the Faculty of Geography and Geology.

name: East European Studies: Languages and Discourses
about: Eastern Europe's history, cultures, conflicts and discourses, taught in English, with two of Russian, Ukrainian or Polish trained to B2+ and B1+.

name: European Studies
about: European politics, culture and society through political, sociological and economic lenses; from year two you specialise in Governing Europe and CEE politics or in Social Change in Europe.

name: Global and Development Studies
about: Globalisation and international development across law, politics, economy, history, society and culture, taught at the Faculty of International and Political Studies.

name: International Relations and Area Studies
about: The global system compared region by region: international relations with area studies, language training and cross-cultural analysis.

name: Mathematics and Computer Science Advanced Track
about: A small research-led maths and computer science degree: a personal mentor from year one, tutorials, research projects and a wide choice of courses.

name: Responsible Entrepreneurship and Management
about: Management and entrepreneurship with a focus on sustainability and the digital economy: start-up culture, data-driven innovation and running organisations internationally, in modules.

name: Joint Bachelor in Sustainability
about: A Una Europa joint degree: year one in Kraków on sustainability basics, then one of six three-semester tracks led by partners such as Helsinki, Paris 1, Madrid or KU Leuven.

name: Medicine, Program in English
about: The six-year medical degree of UJ's School of Medicine in English, running since 1994 with students from about twenty countries; taught in Kraków by UJ and visiting faculty.

name: Dentistry, Program in English
about: The five-year dental degree of UJ's School of Medicine in English, taught alongside the English medical programme at the Faculty of Medicine in Kraków.

name: American Studies
about: The United States studied through culture and religion, literature and politics at UW's American Studies Center in Powiśle, with the chance to spend up to two semesters at another European university.

name: Archaeology
about: Mediterranean-focused archaeology: excavation method, field documentation, data processing and museology, with a field survey and at least three summer excavation seasons in Poland or abroad, from Egypt to Sicily.

name: Business and Management
about: Management with economics, finance and law at the Faculty of Management: running organisations, marketing, finance and people, entrepreneurship, and how the wider environment shapes a business.

name: English Studies
about: A shared first year of Anglophone literature, history and culture, linguistics and practical English; you then pick Linguistics or Literature and Culture for years two and three, placed by first-semester grades.

name: European Politics and Economics
about: European integration with a strong economics side: EU institutions, law, the internal market, trade and currency, taught jointly by the political science and economics faculties, with EU simulations and debates.

name: Finance, International Investment and Accounting
about: Open-economy finance: international trade and investment, exchange rates, global banking and currency risk, with STATA and Excel analysis; the degree is ACCA-accredited, so some professional exams are waived.

name: International Studies in Philosophy
about: Philosophy taught entirely in English since 2007, built on ontology, epistemology and logic in the Lvov-Warsaw School tradition, with ethics, aesthetics and the philosophy of mind, language and politics.

name: Psychology
about: A five-year master's in psychology: three years of core courses from biological foundations to clinical and social psychology, research methods and statistics, then a specialisation such as clinical, business or social research.

name: Social and Public Policy
about: Designing, running and evaluating social and public policy, with law, economics, history and culture alongside; students can apply for a dual degree with Hong Kong Polytechnic University.

name: Undergraduate Programme in International Relations
about: International relations with a firm theory and methods core, plus law, economics, history and culture; 240 hours of language courses, Erasmus+ semesters and a double degree with Kyungpook National University in Korea.

name: Undergraduate Programme in Political Science
about: Political science mixing theory, research methods and practical skills, with electives and particular attention to European integration, Poland and Central and Eastern Europe; taught mainly on the main campus.

name: Biotechnology
about: Lab-heavy biotechnology: molecular biology and genetic engineering, cell culture and bioinformatics, with electives and internships aimed at pharmaceutical, medical and environmental biotech.

name: Business and Administration
about: Leadership, marketing, accounting, finance, management, international economics and law in a common two-year core, then a third-year specialisation in Business, Finance or Governance.

name: Chemistry
about: General chemistry through lectures and lab classes: modern methods of chemical synthesis and physico-chemical techniques for studying the structure of compounds.

name: Criminal Justice
about: Substantive criminal law, criminal procedure, criminology and forensic science, aimed at careers in policing, the courts, prisons and probation, and public or private security.

name: Culture, Thought and Humanity
about: Philosophy applied to culture: how ideas shape cultures and how they can support dialogue between them, with a focus on contemporary crises and humanity's place on the planet.

name: Data and Society
about: Sociology for a data-driven world: how data is produced, read and used in work, cities, migration and digital life, with research workshops where you design studies and analyse real datasets.

name: English for Knowledge, Culture and Innovation
about: Advanced English skills with linguistics and literature; from year two you choose Global English Cultures and Languages or Psycho-Pedagogical Aspects of Language Acquisition.

name: European Cultures
about: Europe's cultural heritage through archaeology, art history, cultural studies, history and social psychology, with most courses chosen by the student.

name: Genetics and Experimental Biology
about: Biology at the cellular and molecular level, with small-group lab work in genetic engineering, histology, cytology and physiology; a new programme.

name: International Relations - Global Studies
about: Globalisation studied as a process in its own right, linking local and global events; the programme includes four semesters of Polish and one of another foreign language.

name: International and European Environmental Law
about: Law on the protection and use of the environment, from human rights to sustainable development, alongside the basic disciplines of law, for work in international bodies and environmental organisations.

name: Political Science
about: Political theory, institutions, campaigns and media analysis, with a third-year specialisation in Media and Politics, Comparative Politics, Global Security or Europe in the World.

name: Applied Computer Science
about: A seven-semester computing engineering degree: programming, algorithms, databases, networks, IoT, cybersecurity, cloud and AI, on a base of maths and physics; a team project replaces the individual engineering thesis.

name: Management
about: A six-semester degree in organisational management at a technical university: economics, finance, accounting, marketing, logistics and operations, with data analysis, IT modules and project leadership.

name: Mechanical Engineering
about: Machine design and manufacturing, specialising in mechanical engineering design: mechanics, strength of materials, thermodynamics, CAD and finite elements, CNC manufacturing, vehicle and hydraulic drive systems.

name: Medical Informatics
about: An engineering degree joining computer science, electronics and medicine: programming, databases and AI alongside anatomy, biophysics, medical imaging and electromedical devices, for building health-care IT systems.

name: Electronic and Computer Engineering
about: Electronics combined with programming, machine learning and robotics: electronic circuits, sensors, microcontrollers, telecommunications and automation, for designing embedded, IoT and robotic systems.

name: Medicine
about: Six-year, 384-ECTS medical degree: anatomy and the scientific basis of medicine, pre-clinical and behavioural subjects, then surgical and non-surgical clinical classes from year four, with 20 weeks of summer clerkships.

name: Dentistry
about: Five-year, 300-ECTS dental degree built to EU standards: basic sciences first, then from year three treating your own patients under supervision at the University Dental Center on the Banacha campus, with four-week summer placements.
